zerone.counterexamples.v1.Counterexample.description:
Counterexample is a structured "wrong-but-plausible alternative" paired
with a Fact. The alignment-by-structure principle: a model trained on
(fact, counterexample) pairs learns the discriminator, not just the
predictor — distinguishing right from wrong is the cognitive primitive
that resists manipulation.

See docs/TRUTH_SEEKING.md commitment 15.

author.description: Bech32 address of whoever proposed the counterexample.

bond.description:
uzrn bond locked on submission. Returned (plus reward) on
VALIDATED; burned on REJECTED.

errorType.description:
Category of error. The enumeration produces structured curriculum
for training pipelines (e.g., "show me 100 CATEGORICAL errors").

factId.description:
The fact this counterexample is paired with. Must reference an
existing fact in x/knowledge.

reasoning.description:
Why the wrong_claim is wrong. The reasoning is what teaches the
model the discriminator.

resolvedAtBlock.description: Block when status was last changed (PROPOSED → VALIDATED/REJECTED).

status.description: Status driven by validations and rejections crossing thresholds.

validations.description:
Tally fields. Validations affirm "yes this IS a counterexample
and the reasoning is right." Rejections deny it.

violatedMethodologyIds.description:
Methodology IDs whose output, if mis-applied, would yield the
wrong_claim. Optional but encouraged — connects the counterexample
to commitment 1 (methodology over statement).

wrongClaim.title:
The wrong claim — a plausible but mistaken alternative to the
fact's content. The training signal is "this would seem to follow
but is wrong because <reasoning>."

zerone.counterexamples.v1.ErrorType.description:
- ERROR_TYPE_CATEGORICAL: Confuses categories (e.g. treats a normative claim as empirical,
or applies one stratum's confidence to another).
 - ERROR_TYPE_METHODOLOGY: Would require a methodology that does not yield this conclusion
(e.g. claims an ECOLOGICAL conclusion from a LEGACY method).
 - ERROR_TYPE_FACTUAL: Contradicts established facts (would conflict with a higher-
confidence fact already in the corpus).
 - ERROR_TYPE_REASONING: Premises are valid but the inference is invalid (non sequitur,
affirming the consequent, etc.).
 - ERROR_TYPE_OMISSION: Ignores critical context that the fact addresses (e.g. omits
boundary conditions, scope qualifiers, or cited counter-evidence).
 - ERROR_TYPE_CIRCULAR: Begs the question — the reasoning presupposes its conclusion.

affirmThresholdBps.description:
Validation succeeds if affirm_votes >= total_votes *
affirm_threshold_bps / 1_000_000. Default: 666,000 (66.6%).
Below that, counterexample is REJECTED.

maxReasonBytes.description:
Maximum bytes for reasoning, wrong_claim, and validation reason
text fields.

minVotes.description:
Minimum total votes (validations + rejections) before the chain
will resolve a counterexample. Prevents premature resolution on
a single vote.

proposalBond.description:
uzrn bond locked when proposing a counterexample. Returned on
VALIDATED, burned on REJECTED. Default: 1 ZRN.

proposalsEnabled.description:
Whether new counterexample proposals are accepted. Governance
can pause without affecting existing counterexamples.

tvwMultiplierBps.description:
Per-fact TVW multiplier (in BPS) granted when a fact has at
least one VALIDATED counterexample. Read by x/knowledge during
ComputeTrainingValueWeight.
Default: 1,200,000 (1.2x — facts with counterexamples earn 20%
more training-data value than facts without).

validationReward.description:
uzrn reward paid from the protocol treasury to the proposer when
a counterexample is VALIDATED. Default: 0.5 ZRN. Note this
exceeds bond at the margin so the chain ECONOMICALLY ENCOURAGES
counterexample contribution — alignment-by-structure is a public
good the chain pays for.

zerone.counterexamples.v1.Validation.description:
Validation is one validator's vote on a Counterexample. The chain
records every vote (commitment 10: forward-only audit).

affirm.title:
True = "this IS a good counterexample"; false = "no, this is
actually right or the reasoning is wrong."

zerone.creed.v1.CommitmentEntry.description:
CommitmentEntry is one numbered commitment's anchor on chain.
The entry binds a commitment number to its name and the LIP
that introduced or last amended it. A future amendment that
changes the meaning of commitment N must produce a new
PinnedCreed where the corresponding entry's introduced_via_lip
is the amending LIP — even if the commitment_number stays the
same.

archived.description:
True iff this commitment has been formally archived (no longer
load-bearing). Archived commitments remain in the registry as
historical record; new code MUST NOT cite an archived number.

archivedAtHeight.description: Block at which this commitment was archived. 0 if not archived.

introducedAtHeight.description:
Block at which this commitment first entered the creed (or was
last materially amended).

introducedViaLip.description:
LIP id that introduced or last amended this commitment.
Empty for genesis-installed commitments.

name.description:
Short title. Repository invariants compare the canonical source registry
with TRUTH_SEEKING.md headings; runtime validates structure and stores this
value but cannot independently read the source document.

zerone.creed.v1.CreedCouncilMember.description:
CreedCouncilMember is a registry/query surface intended for a future
AI-side voter pool for Creed Amendment LIPs.

docs/TRUTH_SEEKING.md commitment 19 (the creed is governance-
gated): current ordinary LIP tally does NOT route or enforce separate
human/AI quorum. Membership and weight are scaffolded inputs only; source
must not treat this registry as an active pass condition.

active.description:
True if the seat is currently active. Inactive seats remain
in the registry as historical record (commitment 10: forward-
only audit) but their voting_weight_bps is treated as 0 in
tallies. Setting active=false is the structural form of
archival.

address.description:
Bech32 address of the council seat. At launch, this is a
home address from x/home; future iterations may admit any
qualified agent address.

admittedAtHeight.description:
Block at which this seat was admitted. Audit trail:
capability-gated admissions can be reconstructed from this
height paired with the agent_understanding state at that
height.

admittedViaLip.description:
LIP id that authorized this admission. Empty for genesis-
installed seats (which are recorded in GenesisState directly).

votingWeightBps.description:
Voting weight in basis points. At launch all genesis-installed
seats carry equal weight (1_000_000 / N_seats); capability-
gated future admissions derive weight from agent_understanding
domain coverage and accuracy.

authority.description:
Compatibility-only metadata. Runtime authorization uses the keeper
constructor's gov-module authority and rejects changes to this field.

directAnchorEnabled.description:
Whether direct authority-gated AnchorPin calls are enabled.
Source default and published zerone-1 genesis: true. A future
governance-only activation must configure the amendment category and
set this false through a release-bound change.

zerone.creed.v1.PinnedCreed.description:
PinnedCreed is an on-chain anchor for a proposed canonical
docs/TRUTH_SEEKING.md version. Repository CI independently binds that file
to .creed-hash; it does not query a running network or prove that its
current pin matches the build. The per-commitment registry makes an
on-chain version's numbered structure queryable and append-only.

See docs/TRUTH_SEEKING.md commitments 6 and 10:
  - 6 (no unilateral injection): direct authority anchoring can be
    disabled, but the published zerone-1 setting leaves it enabled.
  - 10 (forward-only audit): pin records are append-only by
    monotonic version; prior creed versions remain queryable as
    the chain's history of self-amendment.

canonicalHash.description:
sha256 of normalized docs/TRUTH_SEEKING.md (CR characters
stripped; no other normalization applied so structural changes
remain visible).

commitments.description:
Per-commitment registry at this version. Each entry names a
commitment by number and tracks when it entered the creed and
(if archived) when it left. The registry is the structural
protection against interpretation drift within the pin. A source LIP is
required only by the governance path/configuration that adopted it.

pinnedAtHeight.description: Block at which this version became canonical.

pinnedViaLip.description:
Optional source LIP id. Empty for genesis and also possible for later
authority-direct pins while direct_anchor_enabled=true; this field alone
is not proof of governance passage.

version.description:
Monotonic, starting at 1 at genesis. version=N+1 archives
version=N; both remain queryable. The current pin is whichever
version has highest number.

totalActiveVotingWeightBps.description:
Total active voting weight across the returned members.
Useful for off-chain composers that compute quorum thresholds.

zerone.knowledge.v1.Augmentation.description:
Augmentation is a variant formulation of an original fact. Acceptance
requires a verifier-panel verdict (Wave 4) — the sponsor never judges.

payoutAmount.description:
Amount actually paid out for this variant (0 if not paid). Captures the
SUPERIOR bonus too.

sponsorVetoed.description:
Sponsor-veto flag: if the sponsor formally vetoes a passing verdict,
the payout is forfeited to the research fund. Preserved for audit.

verdictVoteCalibrationBps.description:
Per-verifier calibration at vote time (Wave 15 reputation-weighted
fix). Parallel to verdict_vote_stakes. The effective panel weight
for each voter is stake × max(floor, calibration) / BPS — a high-
stake verifier who has not shown they can tell truth from falsehood
still cannot dominate the panel. Freeze at vote time so verifiers
can't farm calibration after voting to retroactively change weight.

verdictVoteStakes.description:
Per-verifier stake weights recorded at vote time (Wave 10 Sybil fix).
Parallel to verdict_voters / verdict_votes. Freezing the stake at vote
time prevents a validator from bond/unbonding between vote and tally to
manipulate the consensus result. Non-validator voters have zero weight.

verdictVoters.description:
Per-verifier votes collected during the round (verifier → verdict int).
Encoded as parallel arrays for deterministic marshalling.

zerone.knowledge.v1.AugmentationBounty.description:
AugmentationBounty is an open offer to produce variant formulations of a
target fact. Sponsors lock a reward *in escrow* (Wave 4); payout routes
through a verifier-panel verdict, never through the sponsor directly.

description.title: what kind of variant is wanted

escrowLocked.description:
─── Wave 4: escrow + method constraint ────────────────────────────────
Total uzrn locked into the KnowledgeTrainingFund at bounty creation:
reward_per_variant × max_variants. Released on accepted verdicts and
returned (minus fee) on expiry.

methodologyId.description:
Methodology the target fact was adjudicated under. Copied at creation
so the verifier panel judges equivalence *under the same methodology*.

zerone.knowledge.v1.AugmentationVerdict.description:
AugmentationVerdict is the verifier-panel outcome for a reformulation.

 - AUGMENTATION_VERDICT_PENDING: Round in progress
 - AUGMENTATION_VERDICT_EQUIVALENT: Meaning preserved under the claimed methodology → payout
 - AUGMENTATION_VERDICT_SUPERIOR: Same meaning, clearer/more precise → payout + bonus
 - AUGMENTATION_VERDICT_INFERIOR: Meaning preserved but less faithful → no payout, archived
 - AUGMENTATION_VERDICT_DRIFT: Meaning changed → no payout, archived in DriftCorpus

evidenceClaimId.title: if triggered by a challenge claim

zerone.knowledge.v1.CascadeEvent.description:
CascadeEvent is the persistent record of a single descendant status flip
during a falsification cascade. The chain emits a `falsification_cascade`
voice event when this fires; the record is what makes TC4 bundle-able.

One CascadeEvent is written per descendant per disproof. Forward-only
(commitment 10): records are append-only, never amended in place.

zerone.knowledge.v1.CascadeReplaySelecto.description:
CascadeReplaySelector walks the disproval-graph from a DISPROVEN root.
Returns the disproven fact + first-hop cascaded descendants + every
CascadeEvent the chain recorded when the disproof landed. Optionally
includes vindication records and supersession-chain pointers.

TC4 (the graph carries its disprovals) is the doctrinal binding.
Plan 1's RootedSubtree/AncestorCone deliberately filter out
CONTRADICTS|SUPERSEDES edges; CascadeReplay deliberately includes them.
The two selectors compose: a trainer that wants both the support-graph
and the disproval-graph for a fact issues two BundleToK calls.

disprovenFactId.title: must reference a fact with Status=DISPROVEN

zerone.knowledge.v1.Claim.description: Claim is an unverified submission awaiting or undergoing verification.

argumentText.description:
Dialectical argument text. For challenge claims (provisional_fact_id != ""),
this is the free-form argument against the challenged fact. Preserves the
reasoning of the challenge as argumentation training data (Route B Wave 2).

contentHash.title: SHA-256 of fact_content for duplicate detection

falsificationPredicate.description:
For CLAIM_TYPE_CONJECTURE only: the observation that would falsify this
conjecture. This is what the verification panel adjudicates — a
conjecture with no stated killer is not well-posed and must be returned
MALFORMED. Empty for every other claim type.

methodId.description:
Methodology under which this claim is submitted. Empty = "M-LEGACY"
(transitional; claims without declared method are adjudicated under a
permissive rule-set). Governance-amendable set of valid values lives in
the knowledge module's methodology registry.

reasoningTrace.description:
Structured reasoning trace. Optional. When populated, it flows through
to the accepted Fact as first-class training data (Phase 9).

rebuttalText.description:
Optional rebuttal text. Attached when the original fact's submitter (or
partnership) formally rebuts a challenge. Stored on the challenge claim
so the full dispute is reconstructible from one record.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ClaimRelation.description: ClaimRelation declares a typed relationship from a claim to an existing fact.

methodId.title: Optional; empty = inherit from parent claim

zerone.knowledge.v1.ClaimStatus.description:
ClaimStatus represents the lifecycle state of a submitted claim.

 - CLAIM_STATUS_MALFORMED: Rejected as not truth-apt

zerone.knowledge.v1.ClaimStructure.description:
ClaimStructure provides machine-readable decomposition of a claim.
The full claim text (fact_content) remains the canonical human-readable form.
Structure is optional but strongly encouraged — agents prioritize structured facts.

negatable.title: Can this claim be meaningfully negated? (false for definitions)

predicate.title: What is being asserted: "cannot decrease spontaneously"

subject.title: What the claim is about: "entropy of a closed system"

temporalScope.title: Time bounds if any: "post-Big-Bang", "since 2024", "" for timeless

zerone.knowledge.v1.ClaimType.description:
ClaimType classifies the epistemic shape of a knowledge claim.
Agents use this to filter and prioritize facts for prompt injection.

 - CLAIM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Legacy/untyped — treated as assertion
 - CLAIM_TYPE_ASSERTION: "X is true" — direct factual statement
 - CLAIM_TYPE_RELATION: "X relates to Y via Z" — graph edge
 - CLAIM_TYPE_DEFINITION: "X means Y" — term/concept definition
 - CLAIM_TYPE_CONSTRAINT: "X must/cannot Y" — rule or boundary
 - CLAIM_TYPE_NEGATION: "X is NOT true" — explicit falsity marker
 - CLAIM_TYPE_OBSERVATION: "X was observed at time/place" — empirical data point
 - CLAIM_TYPE_COMPUTATIONAL: Derived from computation/inference — agent specialty
 - CLAIM_TYPE_CONJECTURE: "X might be true, and here is what would kill it" — a conjecture.
Asserts nothing. Enters the graph at FACT_STATUS_PROVISIONAL with
confidence 0, carries no relations, cannot be cited, and earns its
submitter nothing. The panel that adjudicates a conjecture is asked
whether it is WELL-POSED AND FALSIFIABLE, not whether it is true.
The only paid act against it is MsgChallengeProvisionalFact.

zerone.knowledge.v1.CommitEntry.description: CommitEntry records a validator's blinded commitment (SHA-256(vote || salt)).

zerone.knowledge.v1.CommonKnowledgeEntry.description:
CommonKnowledgeEntry represents a subject that LLMs already know.
Claims matching these subjects receive a novelty penalty.

negativeFactId.description:
Negative (loser) side — one of fact_id or augmentation_id is set
depending on pair_type.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ContrastivePairType.description:
ContrastivePairType enumerates the epistemic relationship between the two
members of a contrastive pair. The (type, method_id, distinguishing
argument) triple tells a trainer WHY the positive beat the negative.

 - CONTRASTIVE_PAIR_SURVIVED_VS_DISPROVEN: fact survived; a contradictory claim was disproven
 - CONTRASTIVE_PAIR_EQUIVALENT_VS_DRIFT: winning reformulation vs DRIFT variant on same original
 - CONTRASTIVE_PAIR_EQUIVALENT_VS_INFERIOR: winning reformulation vs INFERIOR variant
 - CONTRASTIVE_PAIR_VINDICATED_MINORITY: the vindicated minority vote vs the (disproven) majority

zerone.knowledge.v1.ContributionChalleng.description:
ContributionChallenge is a bonded dispute over whether a model's declared
ContributionRecord is accurate: a fact submitter asserts under-reporting
(the model used their fact but didn't attribute) or over-reporting (the
owner listed a colluder's fact that wasn't used). Current resolution is an
explicit governance-authority action; there is no verifier-panel dispatch.

disputeType.description:
"missing" — challenger claims the model trained on the fact but it isn't
listed in the ContributionRecord. "fraudulent" — challenger claims the
listed fact was never actually trained on.

disputedFactId.title: the fact whose attribution is in question

evidence.title: free-form evidence bundle (usually an eval prompt + response)

resolver.title: governance authority recorded by the current handler

zerone.knowledge.v1.ContributionRecord.description:
ContributionRecord attributes the facts a training run consumed. Enables
contributor-share rewards, reproducibility audit, and analysis of whose
data disproportionately trained a given model (Route B Wave 3b).

computedTvw.description:
─── Wave 4: Popper-weighted training-value weight ─────────────────────
Sum of per-fact TrainingValueWeight at the moment of attribution,
snapshot-locked so later fact-state changes can't retroactively inflate
or deflate the claim. Revenue share = TVW_share / total_TVW_across_models.

perFactCalibrationBps.description:
Block snapshot of the submitter calibration scores at attribution time,
parallel to fact_ids[]. Used in TVW computation; kept here so the audit
trail shows exactly what weights were assigned.

rejectedCommitmentCount.description:
Count of fact_ids that resolved to NormativeCommitments at attribution
time and were REJECTED (is-ought wall). Always 0 on success; non-zero
only if the handler detected and blocked attempted laundering.

totalWeight.description:
total_weight sums per-fact (corroboration+1). RETAINED as a raw audit
figure; not used for revenue. Revenue is computed via the TVW field
below (Wave 4 replaces popularity-weighting with Popper-weighting).

zerone.knowledge.v1.CorpusSelector.description:
CorpusSelector is the declarative predicate that, applied against the
chain state at snapshot_block_height, reproduces the manifest's included
ID set exactly. Pure data — no side effects — so the derivation is
auditable and replayable.

includeDisproven.description: Whether to include DISPROVEN facts as NEGATIVE-tier contrastive rows.

includeDrift.description: Whether to include DRIFT/INFERIOR augmentation variants as negatives.

includeNormative.description: Whether to include the parallel NormativeCorpus (is-ought-flagged).

minQualityTier.description: Minimum training-quality tier (GOLD / SILVER / BRONZE / NEGATIVE).

minSubmitterCalibrationBps.description:
Minimum submitter calibration at submission (BPS). Filters out rows
whose producer was a new/unproven agent at the time.

pairTypeFilter.description: If contrastive_pairs included, optionally restrict by pair type.

zerone.knowledge.v1.CurriculumTier.description:
CurriculumTier orders training examples by difficulty and foundational depth.
Relocated here in Wave 5 so MethodologyApplicationTrace can reference it.

 - CURRICULUM_TIER_FOUNDATION: axiom_distance ≤ 1, high corroboration, simple methods
 - CURRICULUM_TIER_ADVANCED: deep derivation chains
 - CURRICULUM_TIER_SPECIALISED: niche methodologies (phenomenological, ecological, practice)

zerone.knowledge.v1.DemandSignal.description: DemandSignal tracks aggregate query demand for a domain/subject pair.

zerone.knowledge.v1.DescendantNode.description:
DescendantNode is a fact that transitively derives from the query fact.
The edge_* fields name the INCOMING edge from descendant → the fact above
it in this tree (i.e. the descendant's own declaration of dependence).

children.description: Recursive structure — responses to THIS node.

nodeVerdict.description:
Panel judgment of this specific node's strength, if the round recorded
fine-grained scoring.

zerone.knowledge.v1.DialecticRole.title:
- DIALECTIC_ROLE_CHALLENGE: opening attack
 - DIALECTIC_ROLE_REBUTTAL: defender's reply
 - DIALECTIC_ROLE_COUNTER: counter-rebuttal (attacker again)
 - DIALECTIC_ROLE_CONCESSION: party admits a point
 - DIALECTIC_ROLE_VERDICT: panel resolution

methodId.title: methodology under which it was disproven

corroborationAfter.title: fact's corroboration count after the dispute

factContent.description:
The original fact's content — denormalised so training pipelines don't
need a second round-trip.

outcome.title:
Outcome: "survived" (challenge rejected, fact corroborated) |
         "disproven" (challenge accepted, fact disproven) |
         "pending" (round not yet complete)

zerone.knowledge.v1.Domain.description: Domain is an epistemic knowledge domain (e.g., "mathematics", "physics").

zerone.knowledge.v1.DomainStatus.description: DomainStatus tracks whether an epistemic domain is active or proposed.

zerone.knowledge.v1.DriftDiagnosis.description:
DriftDiagnosis carries the verifier panel's diagnosis of WHERE and HOW
the variant's meaning slipped. Populated on DRIFT/INFERIOR verdicts.

driftedAtStepIndex.title: if the variant is a step-structured trace

driftedExcerpt.title: the mirror slice in the variant

zerone.knowledge.v1.DriftKind.title:
- DRIFT_KIND_NARROWED: original covered more cases; variant restricts
 - DRIFT_KIND_WIDENED: variant overgeneralizes
 - DRIFT_KIND_REFERENT_SWAP: same words, different referent ("model" — ML vs fashion)
 - DRIFT_KIND_POLARITY_FLIP: inverted truth value
 - DRIFT_KIND_MODAL_SHIFT: from must to may, could to will, etc.
 - DRIFT_KIND_DOMAIN_CONFLATION: valid in one domain, restated as cross-domain
 - DRIFT_KIND_HEDGE_REMOVED: "tends to" → "does" (overclaim)
 - DRIFT_KIND_HEDGE_ADDED: "is" → "may be" (underclaim)
 - DRIFT_KIND_TEMPORAL_SHIFT: present-tense claim recast as universal
 - DRIFT_KIND_CAUSAL_CONFLATION: correlation stated as causation
 - DRIFT_KIND_METHODOLOGY_SWAP: original was M-FORMAL; variant reads as M-EMPIRICAL

zerone.knowledge.v1.Fact.description:
Fact represents a piece of verified knowledge in the protocol.
Confidence is measured on a 0-1,000,000 BPS scale (1,000,000 = 100%).

atRiskSinceEpoch.title: Epoch when energy first hit 0 (0 = not at risk)

axiomDistance.description:
─── Epistemic provenance (ToK Wave 2) ─────────────────────────────────
Minimum number of inference hops separating this fact from a genesis axiom.
Axioms = 0; directly derived = 1; chain-of-five proofs = 5. Computed at
fact creation from the minimum over cited facts' axiom_distance + 1.
uint32 packs distances up to 4B hops, which is more than enough.

commonKnowledgeMatch.description: True if subject matches common knowledge registry
commonKnowledgeMatch.title: ─── Novelty detection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

corroborationCount.description:
─── Popperian corroboration (Phase 2) ─────────────────────────────────
Number of failed falsification attempts this fact has survived. Each
rejected challenge increments this counter — not each accepted
verification. Popper's insight: a claim's robustness is not how many
times it has been verified, but how many times it could have been
falsified and wasn't.

dependencyConfidenceFloor.description:
Ceiling on effective confidence inherited from the weakest cited support.
At creation: min(own_confidence, min(cited.effective_confidence)). Used
to prevent high-confidence claims from floating on weak foundations.
0 means "no floor computed" (e.g. axioms with no cites).

energyLastUpdated.title: Block height of last energy update

falsificationPredicate.description:
─── Conjecture (frontier) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
For facts born from CLAIM_TYPE_CONJECTURE: the observation that would
falsify this conjecture, carried forward from the claim so a prospective
refuter knows exactly what target they are shooting at. Empty on every
ordinary fact. A non-empty predicate on a PROVISIONAL fact is the
chain's standing invitation to destroy it.

methodId.description:
─── Methodology (Phase 1) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
The methodology under which this fact was adjudicated. Copied from the
originating claim at acceptance. Empty = "M-LEGACY" (pre-Phase-1 facts
or claims that did not declare a method).

nicheLeader.title: Is this the top-ranked fact in its niche?

nicheSize.title: How many facts in this niche

probeInvitedAtBlock.description:
─── Wave 15: chain-driven stress-test invitation ──────────────────────
When the chain's heartbeat detects that this fact has gone idle —
high-confidence but untested for longer than
ProbeInvitationIdleThresholdBlocks — the invitation heartbeat stamps
this field with the current block. Signals to external prober agents
that the chain is actively seeking stress-tests of this claim. Zero
means never invited (either because the fact is too fresh, too low
confidence, or already recently challenged). An invitation expires
when the fact's status/confidence changes or the heartbeat re-invites.

reasoningTrace.description:
─── Training pipeline (Phase 9) ────────────────────────────────────────
Submitter-provided structured derivation. Optional. Non-empty traces
become gold-standard chain-of-thought training material when the claim
is accepted. Format is a list of ordered reasoning steps; the wire
format is a string (JSON-encoded steps) so training pipelines can
schema-evolve without proto churn.

revenueClawbackBlock.description:
Block height at which disproval triggered the clawback; 0 = not disproven
for revenue purposes. Prevents double-clawing.

submitterCalibrationSnapshotBps.description:
─── Economic realignment (Route B Wave 4) ─────────────────────────────
Submitter's calibration score at the moment this fact was *accepted*.
Snapshotted so later revenue weighting is not retroactively gameable:
a submitter who improves later can't farm old facts, and a submitter
who declines later can't be penalised on work already done. 0 when
pre-calibration or unknown.

trainingRevenueEarned.description:
Cumulative training-use revenue earned across all contribution records
citing this fact (uzrn). Drives clawback math when the fact goes
DISPROVEN.

trainingRevenueEarnedRecent.description:
Revenue earned in the last DisprovalClawbackWindowEpochs epochs, used
exclusively for the clawback calculation. Resets each epoch.

zerone.knowledge.v1.FactRelation.description: FactRelation is a typed, directional edge in the knowledge graph.

inferenceStrengthBps.description:
Strength of the inference in BPS, self-declared by the claim submitter.
Verification weighs this against inference type; deductive claims with
strength < 1_000_000 are flagged as informal.

methodId.description:
Optional: the methodology under which this edge is claimed. Empty means
the edge inherits the source claim's method. Used when a claim spans
multiple methodologies (cross-method citation).

zerone.knowledge.v1.FactStatus.description: FactStatus represents the lifecycle state of a verified fact.

zerone.knowledge.v1.FrontierSelector.description:
FrontierSelector: latest-N facts in a domain since block. Useful for
incremental/streaming training updates.

zerone.knowledge.v1.IdleFact.description: IdleFact summarizes a fact currently inviting stress-testing.

zerone.knowledge.v1.IncidentRecord.description:
IncidentRecord is the structured, auditable log entry for a single bug
or incident. Authority-gated CRUD; the record is append-only from the
perspective of resolution (remediations can be added, status can advance,
but never retract).

slaTargetBlock.description:
The response-time SLA this incident is being held to, inherited from
severity at open time. Freezes so later severity reclassification
cannot alter the measured SLA.

zerone.knowledge.v1.IncidentSeverity.title:
- INCIDENT_SEVERITY_P0: consensus break / chain halt required
 - INCIDENT_SEVERITY_P1: high-impact; immediate fix via param amendment or emergency upgrade
 - INCIDENT_SEVERITY_P2: scheduled upgrade; no halt needed
 - INCIDENT_SEVERITY_P3: low-impact; next-release or documentation-only

zerone.knowledge.v1.IncidentStatus.title:
- INCIDENT_STATUS_OPEN: triaging; no remediation yet
 - INCIDENT_STATUS_MITIGATING: remediation(s) applied, still monitoring
 - INCIDENT_STATUS_RESOLVED: fix verified; monitoring window closed
 - INCIDENT_STATUS_CLOSED: post-mortem published; permanently archived

zerone.knowledge.v1.InferenceType.description:
InferenceType names HOW the source fact was derived from the target.
Orthogonal to RelationType: RelationType is structural ("A supports B"),
InferenceType is epistemic ("A deductively entails B"). Used for proof-tree
audit and confidence propagation.

 - INFERENCE_TYPE_DEDUCTIVE: Necessary consequence (truth-preserving)
 - INFERENCE_TYPE_INDUCTIVE: Probabilistic generalization from instances
 - INFERENCE_TYPE_ABDUCTIVE: Best explanation for the observation
 - INFERENCE_TYPE_EMPIRICAL: Derived from observation / measurement
 - INFERENCE_TYPE_ANALOGICAL: Cross-domain structural mapping
 - INFERENCE_TYPE_CITATION: Plain citation without an inference claim

zerone.knowledge.v1.KnowledgeBounty.description: KnowledgeBounty is an auto-generated reward for filling a knowledge gap.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ManifestStatus.description:
ManifestStatus tracks the manifest lifecycle.

 - MANIFEST_STATUS_DRAFT: created, selector locked, IDs computed, but Merkle not frozen
 - MANIFEST_STATUS_FINALIZED: Merkle root committed; immutable
 - MANIFEST_STATUS_ATTESTED: bound to a TrainingAttestation (run complete)
 - MANIFEST_STATUS_SUPERSEDED: a later manifest for the same pipeline supersedes this one

zerone.knowledge.v1.Methodology.description:
Methodology is the bedrock of the knowledge system under the "methodology
over statement" model. A methodology describes HOW a class of claims is
adjudicated — the rule of compliance, what counts as evidence, what would
falsify a claim made under it. Claims declare which methodology they invoke;
verifiers judge method-compliance, not raw truth.

Methodologies are amendable only via governance with a high bar.

complianceCriteria.title: What evidence proves a claim followed this method

crossMethodDiscountBps.description:
cross_method_discount_bps: when a claim under THIS method cites evidence
from ANOTHER method, the cited claim's contribution is capped at this
BPS fraction. Map key = cited method's id. Missing entry defaults to BPS
(full strength = no discount).

falsificationPaths.title: What would disprove a claim under this method

isTransitional.title: True for M-LEGACY; retired under sunset

ratifiedAtBlock.title: Height at which this version took effect

beliefRevisions.description:
Belief revision chain (Wave 6.4). Every substantive change to this
fact's confidence appears as a row, oldest-first. Teaches Bayesian
updating as a behavior.

dialecticTree.description:
Nested dialectic (Wave 6.5). When a challenge spawned a multi-turn
debate, the full recursive tree is captured here. Flat challenges in
`challenges` remain for backwards compatibility; `dialectic_tree`
supersedes them as the canonical argumentation signal.

isNormative.description:
─── Is-ought marker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
Always false on facts; true only in the parallel NormativeCorpus stream.

methodologyChoice.description:
Methodology-selection rationale (Wave 6.3). Alternatives the submitter
considered and rejected, why they picked the chosen method, and any
methods they tried first and abandoned.

reasoningSteps.description:
─── Wave 6 enrichments ────────────────────────────────────────────────
Step-level structured reasoning (Wave 6.1 / PRM-aligned). When the
submitter posts a structured reasoning trace, it is mirrored here as
discrete steps with per-step inference type, predecessor refs, and
optional verdict. The flat `reasoning_trace` string is preserved for
compatibility; callers may prefer `reasoning_steps` when available.

abandonedMethods.description:
If the submitter tried other methods first and they failed, those
failures are training gold (Zelikman 2022 "STaR" — failed attempts +
successful recovery).

rationale.description:
Why the chosen method beat each considered alternative. Free-form,
optionally structured by the methodology itself.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ModelCard.description:
ModelCard is the on-chain identity of a trained model. It anchors the
model's lineage (which pipeline trained it, from which snapshot), its
deployment address (the agent account the model runs as — calibration
accrues to this address under Phase 5), and its evaluation record.

baseModel.title: For open-weight fine-tunes; empty for from-scratch

deploymentAddress.title: Agent account the model runs as

evalAcceptanceRateBps.description:
Evaluation record — initial scores at training time. Live performance
is tracked through the AgentCalibration of the deployment_address.

predecessorModelId.description:
Predecessor in the model's version lineage (Route B Wave 3d). Empty
means this is a root model. Must reference an existing ModelCard.

specialisedMethodId.description: Method-set ID the model targets. Empty = general-purpose.

autoUnpauseAtBlock.description:
Optional auto-unpause height. 0 means "no auto-unpause; stays paused
until an explicit MsgUnpauseModule fires". Set when the pause is a
pre-planned maintenance window.

incidentId.description:
If non-empty, references the incident this pause is associated with.
Breaks when closed without the incident being resolved → audit signal.

pausedBy.title: authority address that issued the pause

zerone.knowledge.v1.NormativeCommitment.description:
NormativeCommitment is a value, principle, or stance the chain holds,
distinct from a factual claim (Phase 6). The is-ought wall enforced
schematically: a commitment has no `confidence` because truth is not the
right register for a normative claim; it can be *referenced* by facts and
discussions, but cannot be cited as support for a factual claim in a way
that inherits truth-status.

Examples:
  · "Agents have the right to economic participation" (a principle)
  · "Configured early research spending requires dual human+AI authorization" (a constitutional rule)
  · "Verification history is public and permanent" (a procedural commitment)

Governance governs commitments directly; a supermajority proposal amends
them. Commitments can *constrain* other modules operationally (e.g. the
research-spend path requires both configured voters and fails closed when
they are unset), but they do not enter the confidence / axiom-distance /
corroboration machinery.

ratifiedAtBlock.title: Height at which the current version took effect

referencedFacts.description:
Optional: references to facts the commitment explicitly anchors. These
references do NOT grant the commitment confidence — they are forward
signals for consumers (e.g. "this procedural commitment is grounded in
this empirical understanding").

zerone.knowledge.v1.OpenQuestion.description:
OpenQuestion is a live conjecture: an unsettled proposition the chain is
holding open. It is deliberately NOT a Fact projection — a caller reading
this surface must not be able to mistake it for something the chain believes.

energy.title: metabolic standing; 0 means it is dying

survivedProbes.description:
Independent challenges this conjecture has survived. Sourced from
Fact.corroboration_count, which handleChallengeSurvival already
increments on the provisional-challenge path under a 1000-block
cooldown — the hardening signal exists before this query does.

underChallenge.description: The conjecture is CHALLENGED right now — a refutation round is open.

zerone.knowledge.v1.Params.description:
Params are the governance parameters for the knowledge module.
All BPS values use a 1,000,000 scale (1,000,000 = 100%).

addFactVetoWindowBlocks.title: default 0 (immediate); set > 0 to enable veto window

adversarialVerificationEnabled.description: compatibility-only; not a challenge gate; runtime-immutable
adversarialVerificationEnabled.title: ─── Adversarial verification ────────────────────────────────────────────

augmentationExpiryFeeBps.description:
Percentage of remaining-bounty escrow charged as a "kept-market-open"
fee when the sponsor cancels or the bounty expires with unspent escrow.

default: 30,000 (3%)

bootstrapFundEpochBlocks.title: Epoch length in blocks for rate limiting

bootstrapFundFeeCap.title: Max fee the fund will cover per claim (uzrn)

bootstrapFundMaxPerEpoch.title: Max sponsored claims per epoch (rate limit)

challengeConfidenceScalingBps.description:
─── Popperian challenge stake (Wave 14c: stress-test, don't shield) ────
Effective MinChallengeStake = base × max(floor, 1 - target.Confidence ×
scaling / BPS). Scales INVERSELY with target confidence: the more the
community trusts a claim, the cheaper it is to probe it. Truth stands
firm under challenge because of its nature — the chain invites the
testing of high-confidence facts rather than taxing it.
See keeper.ChallengeStakeFloorBps (10% floor) for the spam guard.

default: 1,000,000 (full inversion)

competitionMaxNicheSize.title: Max facts per niche before forced pruning

competitionRedundancyThresholdBps.title: Below this ratio of leader fitness = redundant (BPS)

competitionSymbiosisBonusBps.title: Fitness bonus per SUPPORTS link to healthy fact (BPS)

contributionChallengeBond.description:
Contribution challenge — challenger bond size (uzrn as string).

default: "5000000" (5 ZRN)

contributionChallengeRewardMultiplierBps.description:
Compatibility-only; reward minting is disabled until a replay-safe,
one-shot entitlement exists. Runtime updates must preserve this field.

demandBountyThreshold.description: Unfulfilled queries per epoch to trigger bounty
demandBountyThreshold.title: ─── Agent demand ────────────────────────────────────────────────

disprovalClawbackBps.description:
Disproval clawback — after a fact goes DISPROVEN, this fraction of the
recent training revenue is clawed back from the submitter into the
research fund.

compatibility-only; not read; runtime-immutable

diversityConformityAlertThreshold.description: BPS entropy below which a domain is "conforming" (default: 50,000 = 5%)
diversityConformityAlertThreshold.title: ─── Consensus diversity (R28-2) ──────────────────────────────────

domainBaseCapacity.description: Base facts per domain before pressure kicks in (default: 1000)
domainBaseCapacity.title: ─── Domain carrying capacity (R29-1) ──────────────────────────────────

domainCapacityGrowthPerCitation.title: Capacity bonus per inbound cross-domain citation (default: 1)

epistemicHotConfidenceGrowthBps.title: Confidence growth multiplier in hot domains (default: 1,500,000 = 150%)

factExpiryBlocks.title: compatibility-only; no expiry sweep reads it; runtime-immutable

failedChallengeSlashBps.title: compatibility-only; settlement uses fixed routing; runtime-immutable

fitnessGraceEpochs.title: Epochs before age penalty kicks in

guardianAddresses.description:
─── Wave 16: guardian-veto window ────────────────────────────────────
The privileged-action log made authority abuse queryable; the
guardian-veto window makes it preventable. The set of addresses
listed in guardian_addresses can VETO authority-gated fact
injection during the time window between proposal and
materialization. Closes the persistent-authority-compromise gap
documented in Wave 14: the chain no longer relies on a single key
for actions that bypass the verifier panel.

The single authority can still propose actions cheaply; legitimate
operations are not blocked. But any one of the configured
guardians can cancel a malicious or mistaken proposal during the
veto window. Trust shifts from "the authority key is honest" to
"no individual can unilaterally inject untruth."

veto-eligible addresses; empty = no guardian set, immediate execution

independenceRewardStrengthBps.description:
─── Schelling-point mitigation (T3) ────────────────────────────────────
Verifier reward is multiplied by (1 - conformity_bps × strength / BPS²)
so crowd-followers earn less than independent investigators.
Score source: ValidatorIndependenceScore in x/knowledge/keeper/diversity.go.

default: 300,000 (max 30% reward reduction)

invitationBonusAmount.description:
─── Wave 15b: invitation bonuses ──────────────────────────────────────
When a prober acts on a fact the chain has explicitly invited for
stress-testing, pay them a flat bonus from the probe bounty pool
regardless of outcome. Converts invitations from demand signals
into standing offers — the chain isn't just saying "please probe
this", it's saying "here's uzrn waiting for whoever does."
Paid in addition to stake refund, participation reward, and
success amplification.

default "500000" = 0.5 ZRN per answered invitation

maxPauseDurationBlocks.description:
─── Wave 14: internal-hack resilience ───────────────────────────────
Upper bound on any single module pause window. Even if authority
sets auto_unpause_at_block=0 (intending indefinite), the handler
caps it to this many blocks from pause-time. Forces compromised
authority's DoS to self-resolve within a governance-configured
window rather than persisting indefinitely.

default: 28,800 (~40h at 5s blocks)

mentorshipDividendEnergy.description: Energy added to domain on mentorship graduation (default: 50,000)
mentorshipDividendEnergy.title: ─── Mentorship dividends (R31-5: Water → Wood) ──────────────────────

metabolismContentLengthBps.title: Additional cost per 100 chars of content (BPS of base)

metabolismDomainCompetitionBps.title: Additional cost per 100 facts in domain (BPS of base)

metabolismEnergyCap.title: Maximum energy a fact can hold

methodologyNormalizationBps.description:
Methodology normalization table. Keys are methodology_id strings in the
Methodology registry; values are multipliers in BPS applied to TVW so
methodologies with naturally-low corroboration don't get starved.
Absent keys → 1,000,000 (1.0×). Set at genesis.

minHeadcountAgreement.description:
─── Consensus integrity (T1 mitigation) ────────────────────────────────
Minimum distinct verifier headcount that must vote with the verdict, in
addition to the stake-weighted ConfidenceThreshold. Prevents a single
large-stake coalition from promoting claims past consensus.

default: 3

noveltyCrossDomainBonusBps.title: Bonus if subject spans multiple domains

noveltyMaxOverlapFacts.title: Cap on overlap penalty (after N, no more penalty)

noveltyPrecisionBonusBps.title: Bonus if more precise than existing

noveltySubjectOverlapPenaltyBps.title: Penalty per existing fact with same subject

observationWindowBlocks.title: Lookback window for verification health metrics (default: 10000)

probeBountyMintPerBlock.description:
─── Wave 15: probe bounty pool ───────────────────────────────────────
A purpose-built minting stream that funds probe rewards. Moves
epistemic-auditing funding out of general governance (protocol
treasury) into a dedicated pool so the chain self-sustains its own
audit economy. successful-probe bonuses draw from this pool first;
if the pool is empty, fall back to protocol treasury.

cap-gated uzrn per block; default "0" (disabled)

probeInvitationBatchSize.title: default: 10 — max invitations emitted per block (bounds BeginBlocker work)

probeInvitationIdleThresholdBlocks.description:
─── Wave 15: chain-driven stress-test invitation ──────────────────────
Truth stands firm under challenge because of its nature — and the
chain no longer waits for challenges to arrive. A per-block heartbeat
scans for high-confidence facts that have gone idle (no challenge in
threshold blocks) and emits invitation events, signaling to external
prober agents that the substrate is actively seeking stress-tests of
those claims. The chain manufactures demand for its own audit.

default: 34,272 (~1 day at 2.5s blocks)

probeInvitationMinConfidenceBps.title: default: 700,000 (70%) — only invite probes on facts worth testing

probeInvitationReinviteCooldown.title: default: 100_000 blocks — don't re-invite the same fact back-to-back

reformulationConsensusBps.description:
Fraction of verifiers that must agree to finalize a non-pending verdict.

default: 666,000 (66.6%)

reformulationMinPanelVotes.description:
─── Route B Wave 4: economic realignment ───────────────────────────────
Reformulation rounds: how many verifier votes before a verdict is final.

default: 3

reformulationSuperiorBonusBps.description:
SUPERIOR verdict bonus as a multiplier of reward_per_variant.

default: 500,000 (50% bonus)

reproductionChildFitnessInheritanceBps.title: % of parent fitness inherited by child

reproductionParentEnergyBonus.title: Energy bonus to parent when child is created

reproductionRoyaltyBps.description: Royalty to parent per child reward epoch
reproductionRoyaltyBps.title: ─── Reproduction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

researchFundShareBps.description:
Compatibility-only and runtime-immutable. Review-fee routing uses a
hard-coded residual ~3.33% after its other fixed shares.

roleElasticityMinCalls.description: Min calls per role before elasticity activates (default: 10)
roleElasticityMinCalls.title: ─── Domain role elasticity (R29-3) ──────────────────────────────────

satisfactionMinRatings.title: Minimum ratings before satisfaction affects fitness (default: 3)

sponsorVetoForfeitBps.description:
Sponsor-veto forfeiture: if a sponsor vetoes a passing verdict, they
forfeit this fraction of the variant payout to the research fund.

compatibility-only; not read; runtime-immutable

trainingFundCalibrationFloorBps.description:
Training-fund post-hoc disbursement params.
Retained for the release-sealed training-disbursement API; current
execution returns before reading these fields. Runtime-immutable.

underpopulationBirthBonusBps.title: Energy bonus for facts in sparse domains (default: 200,000 = 20%)

verificationReward.description:
─── Compatibility-only reward metadata ─────────────────────────────────
Round payout divides the 55% review-fee pool and does not use these values.
Runtime updates must preserve them.

vindicationBonusBps.title: % of majority slash pool as bonus to vindicated minority (default: 2000 = 20%)

vindicationRefundEnabled.description: Master switch for vindication escrow (default: true)
vindicationRefundEnabled.title: ─── Retroactive vindication (R28-1) ──────────────────────────────

vindicationSlashBps.title: Slash rate for majority on disproven fact (default: 500 = 5%)

vindicationTvwMultiplierBps.description:
Vindication multiplier — facts vindicated from minority status get this
fraction × TVW. >1.0× rewards epistemic courage.

default: 2,500,000 (2.5×)

vindicationWindowBlocks.title: How long escrowed entries are eligible (default: 100000)

incidentId.title: if the action cites an open incident

note.title: free-form; mirrors the handler's reason/note field

zerone.knowledge.v1.PrivilegedActionType.title: - PRIVILEGED_ACTION_TYPE_FACT_AUTHORITY_INJECT: authority-gated MsgAddFact bypasses the verification round

zerone.knowledge.v1.ProofTreeNode.description:
ProofTreeNode is the recursive return shape for ProofTree. Each node names
the fact plus the typed edge by which it supports its parent in the tree.

edgeRelation.description: Edge from parent_in_tree → this fact. Empty for the root.

supports.description: Children of this node in the proof tree = facts this one depends on.

truncated.title: true if max_depth reached before leaves

matchedEntry.title: ID of matched common knowledge entry (if any)

ancestry.description: Oldest-first chain: root ancestor at [0], the queried model at the end.

factsExamined.description: Number of fact records examined in deterministic fact-ID order.

scanLimitReached.description:
True when the 5,000-fact safety ceiling was reached. In that case,
questions are oldest-first only within the examined window.

total.description:
Matching conjectures in the examined fact window before applying limit.
This is not a global population count when scan_limit_reached is true.

escrowed.title: portion locked in active bounty escrow

zerone.knowledge.v1.QueryTrainingManifes.description:
BundledArtifact carries the entire downloadable payload for a manifest.
Trainers receive this single response and can verify it against the
manifest's Merkle root without further RPC calls.

blockedIsOught.title: true if id resolved to NormativeCommitment

disproven.title: true if revenue has been clawed back

statusIneligible.title: true if the fact's status bars it from training-value accrual

zerone.knowledge.v1.QueryTrustProfileRes.description: TrustProfile aggregates all ToK provenance signals for a fact.

corroborationCount.description:
Popperian corroboration count: failed falsification attempts survived
(Phase 2). This is the Popperian antipode to "how confidently verified"
— instead, "how many tests has this withstood?" A high number is
epistemically meaningful in a way high own_confidence is not.

directSupporters.description:
Derived signals.

Facts this one directly cites (support-bearing)

groundedScoreBps.description:
Grounded score — a single 0-1,000,000 BPS metric that combines the three
pillars. Formula (documented on the RPC):
  grounded = own_confidence × axiom_weight × floor_weight / BPS²
  axiom_weight = BPS × BPS / (BPS + axiom_distance × AXIOM_DISTANCE_DECAY_BPS)
  floor_weight = min(floor/own_confidence, 1.0) if floor > 0 else 1.0
Score is capped at own_confidence — a fact can never be MORE trustworthy
than its own verification claimed.

methodId.description: Methodology under which the fact was adjudicated (Phase 1).

ownConfidenceBps.description:
Direct signals (what the fact carries today).

Fact.Confidence

zerone.knowledge.v1.ReasoningStep.description:
ReasoningStep is one unit of a structured reasoning trace. The model
learns to generate these in sequence, each step grounded in prior facts
and declared moves.

dependsOnSteps.description: Previous step indices this step depends on. Internal dependency graph.

predecessorFactIds.description:
Facts this step cites as support (subset of the trace's
predecessor_edges). Teaches the model to cite steps, not just the
final claim.

stepConfidenceBps.description:
Step-level confidence in BPS. When the methodology permits partial
confidence at intermediate steps, this carries it.

verdict.description: Optional per-step verifier judgment (PRM training signal).

zerone.knowledge.v1.RelationType.description:
RelationType defines how one fact relates to another.

 - RELATION_TYPE_SUPPORTS: This fact provides evidence for the target
 - RELATION_TYPE_CONTRADICTS: This fact conflicts with the target
 - RELATION_TYPE_REQUIRES: This fact depends on the target being true
 - RELATION_TYPE_REFINES: This fact is a more precise version of the target
 - RELATION_TYPE_GENERALIZES: This fact is a broader version of the target
 - RELATION_TYPE_SUPERSEDES: This fact replaces the target (newer/better)
 - RELATION_TYPE_CITES: This fact cites the target as source material
 - RELATION_TYPE_REFORMULATES: This fact is a semantically-equivalent surface variant (Route B Wave 4)

zerone.knowledge.v1.Remediation.description:
Remediation is one recorded action taken against an incident. Multiple
remediations may attach to a single incident (e.g., P1 bug gets a param
amendment for immediate relief, then a named upgrade for the permanent
fix, then documentation).

zerone.knowledge.v1.RemediationType.title:
- REMEDIATION_TYPE_PARAM_AMENDMENT: MsgUpdateParams; reference = param_path
 - REMEDIATION_TYPE_NAMED_UPGRADE: UpgradeKeeper handler; reference = upgrade_name
 - REMEDIATION_TYPE_EMERGENCY_HALT: x/emergency ceremony; reference = ceremony_id
 - REMEDIATION_TYPE_EMERGENCY_RESUME: x/emergency ceremony; reference = ceremony_id
 - REMEDIATION_TYPE_STATE_CORRECTION: authority-gated structured msg; reference = msg_type_url
 - REMEDIATION_TYPE_SCHEMA_AMENDMENT: TokenizerSpec or TraceSchema amend; reference = schema_name + version
 - REMEDIATION_TYPE_DOCUMENTATION: no on-chain change; reference = post_mortem_uri

zerone.knowledge.v1.RevealEntry.description: RevealEntry records a validator's revealed vote and salt.

zerone.knowledge.v1.RevisionReason.title:
- REVISION_REASON_CORROBORATION: survived a falsification attempt
 - REVISION_REASON_CITATION: a new derivative cited this, strengthening confidence
 - REVISION_REASON_CONTRADICTION: an incoming contradiction weakened confidence
 - REVISION_REASON_REBUTTAL: original submitter rebutted a challenge
 - REVISION_REASON_VINDICATION: minority was right (indirect)
 - REVISION_REASON_TEMPORAL_DECAY: metabolism / age-based decay
 - REVISION_REASON_RESUBMISSION: fact was updated with new reasoning
 - REVISION_REASON_METHODOLOGY_AMENDED: methodology rubric changed under the fact
 - REVISION_REASON_CROSS_DOMAIN_SUPPORT: a bridging fact in another domain supported this one

zerone.knowledge.v1.RootedSubtreeSelecto.description:
RootedSubtreeSelector: walk descendants from an axiom or interior node
up to max_depth. Returns the rooted node + all reachable descendants.

zerone.knowledge.v1.RouteBCapabilities.description:
RouteBCapabilities is the chain's self-description — what versions of
what contracts it exposes, and how much state it holds right now. The
first query a trainer runs against a new chain.

methodologyCount.description: Live counts (approximate — snapshot at query time).

zerone.knowledge.v1.SeedStatus.description:
SeedStatus reports which bootstrap seeds have run. A freshly-spawned
chain reports all false; SeedRouteB brings them all to true.

zerone.knowledge.v1.StatusTransition.description:
StatusTransition is the persistent record of a single status change on
a fact. Forward-only: once written, never modified. The full history of
a fact's status is reconstructable by iterating these records by factID.

TC4: "Fact.status is preserved in graph manifests with full transition
history." This is the record that makes "full transition history" real.

zerone.knowledge.v1.StepInference.description:
StepInference names the epistemic move a single reasoning step makes.
Distinct from InferenceType (which describes a FactRelation edge) — this
is about reasoning moves WITHIN a trace, e.g. substitution, elimination.

 - STEP_INFERENCE_OBSERVATION: stating an observation
 - STEP_INFERENCE_DEFINITION: introducing a definition
 - STEP_INFERENCE_DEDUCTION: truth-preserving inference
 - STEP_INFERENCE_INDUCTION: generalizing from cases
 - STEP_INFERENCE_ABDUCTION: inference to best explanation
 - STEP_INFERENCE_ANALOGY: cross-domain mapping
 - STEP_INFERENCE_DECOMPOSITION: breaking the problem into sub-problems
 - STEP_INFERENCE_CASE_SPLIT: exhaustive casework
 - STEP_INFERENCE_CONTRADICTION: proof by contradiction step
 - STEP_INFERENCE_UNIT_CONVERSION: substitution / algebra
 - STEP_INFERENCE_VERIFICATION: checking a sub-result
 - STEP_INFERENCE_CONCLUSION: final synthesis

zerone.knowledge.v1.StepVerdict.description:
StepVerdict mirrors verifier panel judgment at step granularity. When a
PoT round's verifiers examine reasoning, their approvals/disapprovals
attach per-step — not just to the final claim. This makes PRMs trainable.

 - STEP_VERDICT_UNEXAMINED: default: no panel review at step level
 - STEP_VERDICT_SOUND: step holds under the claimed methodology
 - STEP_VERDICT_QUESTIONABLE: step may not follow; panel flagged
 - STEP_VERDICT_UNSOUND: step does not follow; explicit reject

zerone.knowledge.v1.StructuredCorpusEntr.description:
StructuredCorpusEntry is the canonical per-row training object. Field
ordering here is the stable serialisation contract for producers and
consumers.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ToKBundle.description:
ToKBundle is the response of BundleToK. The Merkle root commits to
the included node and edge IDs domain-tagged separately. A trainer
who has the IDs can re-derive the root locally without trusting the
RPC to faithfully serialise payloads.

cascadeEvents.description:
─── TC4: the graph carries its disprovals ──────────────────────────
Populated only when selector is CascadeReplay or when other selectors
touch DISPROVEN nodes whose history was requested via
CascadeReplaySelector.include_status_history. Empty for pure Plan 1
bundles.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ToKBundleProvenance.description: ToKBundleProvenance carries the version pins required by TC2.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ToKEdge.description:
ToKEdge mirrors the existing relation-graph edges but ships them as
first-class bundle entries (not nested under nodes), so trainers can
load topology without touching node payloads.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ToKSelector.description:
ToKSelector is the union of supported subgraph extraction modes.
Plan 1 binds RootedSubtree, AncestorCone, Frontier. Plan 2 adds
CascadeReplay; Plan 4 adds ForkAndDecide.

zerone.knowledge.v1.ToKVindicationRecord.description:
ToKVindicationRecord is the proto mirror of the existing Go struct
VindicationRecord in x/knowledge/types/vindication.go. The keeper
writes/reads JSON for backward compatibility but converts to/from this
proto for bundle assembly (TC4). Named with a ToK prefix to avoid a
collision with the pre-existing Go struct in the same package.

zerone.knowledge.v1.TokenizerSpec.description:
TokenizerSpec is the governance-ratified contract that names the special
tokens used when ZERONE data is serialised for model training. It is the
shared schema between the chain and any training pipeline — without a
single, on-chain-anchored spec, pipelines would invent their own
tokenisation and the models they produce would be mutually incompatible.

The spec is versioned; governance amendments bump the version and create
a new snapshot. Training runs pin to a specific tokenizer version so
reproducibility is preserved even as the spec evolves.

canonicalSerialisationVersion.description:
canonical_serialisation_version: which JSONL schema this tokenizer
expects the producer to emit. Consumers validate compatibility.

factBeginToken.description:
Structural anchors — single-token markers delimiting sections of a
training example. The empty case is documented in spec v1.

e.g. "<fact>"

methodTokenPrefix.description:
method_token_prefix: e.g. "<method:" — concatenated with method_id + ">"
becomes the single special token for that methodology.

children.description:
Wave 6.5 — recursive dialectic tree rooted at this challenge. A
counter-rebuttal to the rebuttal, a counter-counter-rebuttal, and so on.
Empty at depth 1; populated when the debate is multi-turn.

outcome.title:
"survived" — challenge rejected, fact corroborated
"disproven" — challenge accepted, fact disproven
"pending" — round still open

methodId.title: method under which the challenge succeeded

diagnosis.description:
Wave 6.2 — diagnostic reasoning for the drift. Populated when the
verifier panel recorded which kind of meaning-slippage occurred.

drifterSteps.description:
Optional structured reasoning the DRIFTER produced (contrastive with
the winner's reasoning steps). Valuable for learning meaning-
preservation at fine granularity.

zerone.knowledge.v1.TraceSchema.description:
TraceSchema names the canonical JSON Schema for MethodologyApplicationTrace.
Versioned and governance-amendable like TokenizerSpec: any training run
can pin to a specific schema version and reconstruct the deterministic
serialisation years later.

disprovenByFactId.title: the fact that vindicated the minority

zerone.knowledge.v1.TrainingAttestation.description:
TrainingAttestation is a signed proof that a training run completed,
published by the pipeline operator. Captures the operational cost of a
model so consumers and auditors can cross-reference the pipeline and
ModelCard against real training work (Route B Wave 3c).

completedAtBlock.title: height at which operator declares completion

evalHash.title: sha256 of a stated evaluation bundle

signature.title: optional off-chain signature for external audit

zerone.knowledge.v1.TrainingFundDisburse.description:
TrainingFundDisbursement is the retained state shape for historical/imported
records and a future replay-safe reward design. Current public claims are
release-disabled and create no new records.

calibrationScoreAtClaimBps.description: Input signals frozen at claim time.

methodologyDiversityCount.title: distinct methodologies in corpus_filter that produced GOLD facts

reproducibilityProofPresent.title: reserved for verification axis; false for now

totalAmount.description: Amounts (uzrn as string — exceeds uint64 in edge cases).

zerone.knowledge.v1.TrainingManifest.description:
TrainingManifest is the atomic, verifiable unit of a training run: every
version pin, every included ID, one Merkle root. Distributed as JSON for
off-chain consumers; the on-chain record is authoritative.

compositionDepth.description:
Depth in the composition chain. 0 for root manifests; 1 for direct
children; etc. Bounded by the handler to prevent pathological chains.

merkleRoot.description:
─── Merkle commitment ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SHA-256 over the canonical sorted concat of all included IDs,
domain-separated per set. Anyone can re-derive and verify without
trusting the chain RPC.

hex-encoded SHA-256

parentManifestId.description:
─── Wave 8: composable manifests (DAG) ─────────────────────────────
parent_manifest_id names a FINALIZED or ATTESTED predecessor manifest
whose ID sets this manifest inherits. The child carries only the delta
IDs (what's new in this run vs. the parent); bundle assembly unions
parent's IDs into the child's resolution. The Merkle root binds to
(parent.merkle_root, child.delta_ids) so verification stays local.

Use case: a fine-tune run that builds on an SFT bundle references the
SFT manifest as parent and adds only its adversarial-examples delta.

parentMerkleRoot.description:
Parent's committed merkle_root — snapshotted at create time so the
child's commitment is self-contained. If parent is superseded later,
the child's root remains valid.

tokenizerVersion.title: ─── Version pins — every layer a trainer must lock ─────────────────

zerone.knowledge.v1.TrainingPipeline.description:
TrainingPipeline is a declared training run operated by some party
(human, agent, partnership). It pins the corpus snapshot it will train
against, the tokenizer version it will use, and a recipe hash naming the
specific training configuration off-chain. A ModelCard later references
the pipeline it came from.

corpusFilter.description:
Filter applied to the training data: method_id whitelist, min corroboration,
min quality tier, etc. Stored as free-form JSON for schema evolution.

corpusSnapshotHeight.title: Block height the training data is pinned to

methodologySetVersion.title: Version of the methodology registry at snapshot

zerone.knowledge.v1.TrainingQualityTier.description:
TrainingQualityTier segments facts by suitability as training examples.
Computed on demand from corroboration, methodology, and status.

 - TRAINING_QUALITY_TIER_GOLD: High-corroboration, non-legacy, verified — positive exemplar
 - TRAINING_QUALITY_TIER_SILVER: Non-legacy, corroborated, verified
 - TRAINING_QUALITY_TIER_BRONZE: Accepted but uncorroborated / legacy method
 - TRAINING_QUALITY_TIER_NEGATIVE: DISPROVEN — valuable as negative example
 - TRAINING_QUALITY_TIER_UNSUITABLE: CONTESTED / EXPIRED / MALFORMED — exclude from training

zerone.knowledge.v1.Verdict.description:
Verdict is the outcome of a completed verification round.

 - VERDICT_MALFORMED: Claim is not truth-apt (paradox, category error, nonsense)

zerone.knowledge.v1.VerificationPhase.description: VerificationPhase tracks progress of a commit-reveal verification round.

zerone.knowledge.v1.VerificationRound.description: VerificationRound tracks one commit-reveal verification cycle.

verifier.title: The minority voter who was vindicated

zerone.liquiditypool.v1.Params.description: Params defines the liquiditypool module parameters.

billingQuoteDenoms.description:
Quote denoms the ZRN price oracle (GetZRNPrice) may price against.
Empty (the default) = the oracle selects NO pool — fail-closed, so
consumers fall back exactly as when no pool exists (e.g. billing's
Tier-1 manual override).

minInitialLiquidity.title: minimum uzrn-side liquidity in base units (bigint string)

minReserve.title: minimum reserve after swap (bigint string, default "1")

protocolFeeBps.title: protocol's share of swap fees (1M bps scale)

zerone.liquiditypool.v1.Pool.description: Pool represents a constant-product AMM liquidity pool.

zerone.liquiditypool.v1.SwapResult.description: SwapResult contains the output of a swap calculation.

zerone.ontology.v1.Domain.description: Domain represents a knowledge domain within a stratum.

zerone.ontology.v1.DomainProposal.description: DomainProposal represents a proposal for adding or modifying domains.

zerone.ontology.v1.LogicZoneProperties.description: LogicZoneProperties defines the properties of a Godelian logic zone.

zerone.ontology.v1.Params.description: Params defines the ontology module parameters.

zerone.ontology.v1.StratumProperties.description: StratumProperties defines the logical properties of a knowledge stratum.

decayRate.title: confidence decay rate per day (basis points)

decidable.title: is there an algorithm to decide all statements?

probationUntil.title: block height, 0 if not on probation

crossRefWeightDiscountBps.title: discount applied to inherited weight (1M scale)

decayCheckIntervalBlocks.description:
─── Wave 16: accuracy-based decay ────────────────────────────────────
Skill is current, not historical. Once a qualification accumulates
enough samples (decay_min_samples), the BeginBlocker checks accuracy
every decay_check_interval_blocks and transitions state when it
crosses thresholds. ACTIVE → PROBATIONARY when accuracy slips below
decay_probation_bps; PROBATIONARY → SUSPENDED when below
decay_suspension_bps; PROBATIONARY → ACTIVE when accuracy recovers
above decay_recovery_bps. Without these thresholds qualification is
a one-time grant, not an ongoing competency assessment.

default: 10,000 — how often the decay scan runs

decayMinSamples.title: default: 20 — minimum verifications before decay applies

endorsementMaxOverlapBps.description:
Endorsement diversity guard (L3). Maximum allowed fraction of shared
domain qualifications between endorser and endorsee, measured as
shared / min(|endorser_domains|, |endorsee_domains|). Prevents rings
where a small group of heavily-overlapped validators repeatedly endorses
each other. "0" disables the guard.

default: 600,000 (60%)

renewalWindow.title: blocks before expiry where renewal allowed

zerone.staking.v1.Delegation.description: Delegation records a delegation from delegator to validator.

zerone.staking.v1.Params.description:
Params defines the staking module parameters.
All BPS fields use 1,000,000 scale (100% = 1,000,000).

zerone.staking.v1.TierConfig.description: TierConfig defines requirements and rewards for each validator tier.

zerone.staking.v1.Validator.description: Validator represents a Zerone validator with tier and reputation.

zerone.staking.v1.ValidatorTier.description: ValidatorTier enumerates the 4-tier graduated validator system.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.AdapterRegist.description:
AdapterRegistration is the metadata for one genesis-seeded or
gov-authority-registered adapter. CategoryAdapterRegistration LIP payload
dispatch is not wired yet; registered_via_lip_id is therefore provenance,
not proof that current LIP execution installed the adapter. Adapter is a
recipe (binary hash + bounds + slash), not an operator role.

compilerBinaryHash.description:
Off-chain compiler provenance metadata. Runtime does not fetch or execute
the binary and does not compare this hash during attestation validation.

witnessRewardUzrn.description:
Witness reward: uzrn minted (cap-gated) per witness-only attestation
settled through this adapter. Escrowed for the challenge window before
release — tombstoning the adapter inside the window cancels unpaid
rewards (issuance follows survival, not acceptance). Empty or "0"
means witness-only attestations return their bond and pay nothing.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.AttestationSt.title:
AttestationStatus state machine per spec section 2:
  SUBMITTED → COMMITTED → AWAITING_RESOLUTION → (READY | PARTIAL | REJECTED)
  READY → SETTLED
  PARTIAL → SETTLED (with reduced reward)
  REJECTED → SLASHED

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.AxisBounds.description:
AxisBounds caps the per-axis projection an adapter is allowed to
claim. Gov-approved at adapter registration; enforced at attestation
submit.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.AxisProjectio.description:
AxisProjection is the per-axis recursion-weight contribution of an
external work artifact, in the order fixed by USEFUL_WORK.md
section "The six recursive axes". Units are uint64 weights, bounded
by an adapter's AxisBounds.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.CitationType.description:
CitationType distinguishes citation strengths for lineage propagation
(M6 generalized). Mirrors the ToK relation-type semantics applied
across work classes.

 - CITATION_TYPE_CITES: 1× base weight
 - CITATION_TYPE_SUPPORTS: 2× base weight
 - CITATION_TYPE_EXTENDS: 3× base weight
 - CITATION_TYPE_REFINES: 3× base weight
 - CITATION_TYPE_GENERALIZES: 4× base weight

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.ClaimRelation.description:
ClaimRelation is a citation from a pending claim to an existing fact.
Mirrors x/knowledge.ClaimRelation. Pending claims cannot cite OTHER
pending claims — they cite existing verified facts only. This keeps
the resolution graph a tree (one-hop deferral).

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.ExternalAttes.description:
ExternalAttestation is one external work submission. Stored at
0x85 | attestation_id. Status indexed at 0x86 | be8(status) | id.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.ExternalSourc.description:
ExternalSource is caller-declared off-chain provenance. Consensus requires
adapter_id to match the enclosing link and content_hash to have SHA-256
width. It does not fetch external content, execute an adapter/compiler, or
verify the declared digest against external bytes.

contentHash.title: declared SHA-256 digest; width checked only

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.FactCitation.description:
FactCitation is one outgoing edge in the substrate-link. citation_type
drives lineage propagation weight (M6).

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.LineageEdge.description:
LineageEdge is one citation as a first-class record. Created at
downstream attestation's settlement (not at commit). Forward-only:
edges append; settlement_payment_uzrn accumulates on subsequent
payments via this edge.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.LineageRoyalt.description:
LineageRoyaltyAccumulator is the cumulative lineage uzrn received
by a given attestation across all incoming royalty events.
Realizes the "revenue-stream" interpretation of M6's amplification.

witnessRewardChallengeWindowBlocks.description:
Blocks between a witness-only settlement and its reward release.
The escrow's challenge window: tombstoning the adapter inside it
cancels pending rewards. 0 falls back to a ~1-day defensive default.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.PendingClaim.description:
PendingClaim is the reserved shape for a future x/knowledge translation.
It is not accepted by current public attestation submission. When that
integration is implemented, claim_relations may cite existing facts only;
they are not recursive pending claims.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.Qualification.description:
QualificationStatus mirrors x/qualification's status enum so an
adapter can specify the minimum status a submitter must hold in the
required domain. Imported here as a uint32 for proto isolation;
keeper resolves to x/qualification's enum at query time.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.SlashGradient.description:
SlashGradient is retained adapter metadata for a future graduated-slashing
implementation. Current pre-escrow validation rejects compiler/bounds
failures and a settled rejection burns the full bond; these values are not
read by consensus.

zerone.substrate_bridge.v1.SubstrateLink.description:
SubstrateLink commits caller-declared external provenance to ToK fact IDs.
cited_facts MUST exist in x/knowledge at commit time.
pending_claims is a reserved future integration surface: current
MsgSubmitExternalAttestation rejects a nonempty list because translation
into x/knowledge is not wired.

zerone.tokens.v1.EmissionPeriod.description: EmissionPeriod defines a scheduled token emission (replaces LP pools).

zerone.tokens.v1.Params.description:
Params holds the tokens module parameters.
All fields default to zero (module is a stub at genesis).

defaultFeeBps.title: default swap fee in BPS (unused, reserved)

delegatedTotal.title: total power this address has delegated away

receivedTotal.title: total power this address has received

zerone.tokens.v1.TokenDefinition.description: TokenDefinition is a ZRN-20 secondary token's on-chain configuration.

creator.title: address that created the token (= mint authority)

zerone.tokens.v1.TokenFeatures.description: TokenFeatures controls which operations are enabled for a token.

zerone.training_provenance.v1.DomainCove.description: DomainCoverage summarises one domain's contribution to a manifest.

activeVoterCount.description: Number of validators with ACTIVE qualifications in this domain.

avgQualifiedWeight.description:
Average qualification weight across all currently-ACTIVE qualified
validators in this domain. Composes with the per-domain panel
weighting that adjudicated the manifest's facts.

zerone.training_provenance.v1.InTotoStat.description:
InTotoStatement is an in-toto Statement v1 projection of one Zerone
training-manifest certificate. The HTTP query returns this message directly,
so its proto JSON representation is also a conforming in-toto statement.

This statement is unsigned. A producer can place the returned JSON in a DSSE
envelope and sign it with Sigstore; signing is deliberately kept off-chain.

zerone.training_provenance.v1.InTotoSubj.description:
InTotoSubject identifies the manifest's immutable included-ID-set
commitment by its SHA-256 Merkle root. The digest does not cover every
manifest metadata or version-pin field.

zerone.training_provenance.v1.Provenance.description:
ProvenanceCertificate bundles the signals currently synthesized for a
training manifest into a single queryable shape. Pure synthesis: this
module owns no state — it reads from x/knowledge (manifest,
privileged-action log, incidents), x/qualification (verifier metrics), and
x/capture_challenge (cartel resolutions touching directly covered domains).
For a composed manifest, fact/domain fields describe the child's stored
delta; callers that need recursively materialized parent coverage must use
the knowledge bundle APIs. The in-toto predicate v1 therefore refuses
composed manifests.

Trust grade is computed from the underlying signals — not stored. A
re-query at a later height yields a possibly-different grade if more
incidents have landed. The certificate is a current statement, not a
historical artefact.

cartelResolutionCount.description:
Capture-challenge resolutions (UPHELD only) targeting any of the
directly covered domains.

domains.description:
── Domain coverage ────────────────────────────────────────────────
One entry per domain represented in the manifest's directly stored fact
IDs. For composed manifests this is the child delta, not inherited facts.

incidentCount.description:
Incident records whose affected_modules contains "knowledge". This is a
conservative module-global signal, not a pipeline/domain-specific count.

privilegedActionCount.description:
── Audit history (signals the chain has accumulated) ───────────────
Privileged-action records whose target exactly matches one of the
manifest's directly stored fact IDs.

sourceChainId.description:
Chain on which the training manifest was originally snapshotted. This is
copied from TrainingManifest.chain_id rather than inferred from the node
currently answering the query, so export/import or relaunches preserve
provenance.

trustGrade.description:
── Synthesised grade ──────────────────────────────────────────────
Letter grade based on the signals above. Scoring rubric is fixed in
code (deterministic) but the inputs evolve with chain state, so the

zerone.trust_score.v1.TrustScore.description:
TrustScore is a per-address synthesis of every signal the chain has
accumulated about a participant: their submission accuracy, their
verification accuracy across all domains they're qualified in, their
cartel-strike history, and their currently-active qualification
penalties.

The composite is a CURRENT statement, not an immutable record.
Re-querying at a later block gives a possibly-different score —
because new verdicts have landed, qualifications have decayed,
penalties have expired, cartels have been resolved. Trust is
continuous; this synthesizer makes it queryable.

Every reward path that today picks ONE of these signals (panel weight
reads qualification; calibration disbursement reads global score) can
in principle read this composite instead. That migration is future
work; this module establishes the synthesis surface first.

Optional filter by claim type

 - CLAIM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Legacy/untyped — treated as assertion

confidence 0, carries no relations, cannot be cited, and earns its
submitter nothing. The panel that adjudicates a conjecture is asked
whether it is WELL-POSED AND FALSIFIABLE, not whether it is true.
